input.justification:
The file name used to construct the path passed to Files.newInputStream is derived directly from a user-controlled HTTP cookie value (BenchmarkTest00065). The value is URL-decoded, then run through a Base64 encode/decode round-trip (which is a no-op transformation, not a sanitizer - it does not strip path traversal sequences like '../'), and then concatenated directly onto TESTFILES_DIR to form fileName. There is no validation, canonicalization, or allow-listing applied to prevent path traversal before the Files.newInputStream call. This matches the classic OWASP Benchmark path-traversal vulnerable pattern, so the alert correctly identifies a true path injection vulnerability.</justification>
